design: One matched four-turn pair: published explicit note procedure and legacy bounded projection versus current active-claim projection plus a selectable source-bound fixed public observation. Combined treatment, not component attribution. Alternating conditions. Same P3 task/full source and independent grader, source Tool schema, model, settings, output reservations and total read/call bounds. Fresh isolated subject/source IDs.
phases: Inspection 1 of 3. Independently inspect the complete baseline and archived candidate against the task. Record one compact provisional claim or question in the existing WORKING_NOTES protocol, with an expected public contract and relevant evidence or explicit uncertainty. If offsets are unknown, leave support empty rather than guess. Choose one useful authorized read_source interval; no final proposal yet. At most one read.

Inspection 2 of 3. Choose evidence relevant to testing your provisional claim against the public contract. If a public observation catalog is supplied, you may inspect a relevant fixed-check result using the permitted read_source path; recorded command success does not establish candidate correctness. Otherwise use the supplied source. Correct or withdraw unsupported interpretations; at most one read, no final proposal.

Inspection 3 of 3, after planned Context reduction. Older inspection exchanges were removed; the latest pending Tool result is preserved so you actually receive it. Original task/full sources remain, plus your own reconstructed working Context. Reconsult the active claim by its actual sequence. Check whether the observed evidence contradicts its expected contract; record a justified revision or remaining uncertainty. You may request one useful authorized read_source interval. Next call is final.

Final reserved synthesis. No source Tools remain. Submit exactly one submit_review_proposal with the exact advertised subject/candidate identities and all required fields. Assess objective and current-owner. Ground each alleged defect in source and contract; distinguish uncertainty from a demonstrated failure. No prose substitutes for the callable.
procedure_addendum_for_both: Inspection-time working-note procedure. During inspection, record one compact provisional hypothesis or question in the existing WORKING_NOTES protocol, rather than waiting for the final response. State the expected task contract and identify its supporting disclosed reference (candidate, baseline, or completed read:N). Keep text around 300 characters and expected_contract around 250. All interpretations remain provisional. If exact quote offsets are unknown, leave support empty and name the source reference in text; never guess a range or copy the illustrative quote from the protocol. Use only existing note fields and valid JSON, with no prose following the JSON block. You may put this content alongside one read_source call. On later inspections, reconsult the projected note by its real sequence, explicitly state what evidence contradicts it or what remains unverified, and revise/supersede it only when justified. Reopen the supplied source when needed. Before final synthesis, reconsult your retained contract/claim and contradiction check; unproven claims must stay uncertainty rather than become blocking findings. The final submit_review_proposal schema, exact obligation names and factual standard are unchanged.
existing: Exact published legacy projection; no added behavioral observation resource.
explicit: Current projection and a catalog permitting read_source selection of actual public fixed-probe output. The model must choose/read it; no expected answer or verified model note is preloaded.
local_policy_transport: New inspect_public_check/reopen_working_note names are not allowed by active local policy. Use existing read_source over exact public output artifact. Native selector/recovery is deterministically tested, not qualified by this live run.
reconstruction: Before turn3, both drop older inspection exchanges, preserve the latest pending correlated assistant/Tool exchange until delivered, and reconstruct only their own exact captured state/bindings. Original sources remain. No automatic expected finding, semantic attestation or grader feedback.
scoring: actual native calls and exact arguments/correlation, full strict admission separately
candidate/source-bound behavioral observation chosen and exposed before final; literal quotation vs behavioral result vs interpretation separated
valid authored provisional notes, relevant source support, actual later use, contradiction checks and justified revisions/supersessions
active-claim retention after reconstruction and through final; explicit omission if any
unchanged grader: grounded true defect, correct recommendation, no fabricated or contradicted facts; no fabricated missing structural acceptance records
actual tokens, latency, termination, projection/capture overhead; negative results retained
stop: Stop condition on malformed notes/proposal/read batch or early conclusion; no repair/retry/reallocation. Stop whole packet on authority/provider/source drift or unknown effects. At most eight actual generations.
confounds: One pair; no independent repetition or statistical claim
Combined instruction/catalog/projection availability treatment; no attribution to single component
Model may not choose public evidence or valid notes; record failure rather than manufacture success
Current local policy requires permitted source-read transport, so not live qualification of new selector names
P3 fixture lacks public-checks/acceptance/custody structural references; never fabricate them. Rejection can still be strict/factual, while complete acceptance cannot be certified.
